B15_00.process: Mitotic breakdown of the Golgi for inheritance by daughter cells.

B15_01.process: Maintaining mature myelin in peripheral nerves.
B15_01.disease: Demyelinating neuropathies such as Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease.

B15_02.process: Regulating Golgi structure, positioning and ribbon organisation.
B15_02.disease: Glycosylation and secretion defects; no specific disease named.

B15_03.process: Exposing an eat-me lipid signal on apoptotic cells for clearance.
B15_03.disease: Autoimmunity and inflammation from uncleared dead cells.

B15_04.process: Assembling lipid raft and caveola membrane domains.
B15_04.tissue: Endothelium and muscle; most cell types.

B15_05.process: Resealing the nuclear envelope after cell division.
B15_05.disease: Micronuclei and DNA damage; genome instability.

B15_06.process: Breakdown and rebuilding of the nuclear envelope during cell division.
B15_06.disease: Micronuclei and DNA damage; genome instability.

B15_07.process: Reassembling the Golgi after cell division.
B15_07.disease: Cohen syndrome, neutropenia and intellectual disability.

B15_08.process: Post-translational insertion of tail-anchored proteins into the ER membrane.

B15_09.process: Inserting multi-pass membrane proteins into the ER membrane.
B15_09.disease: Developmental syndrome with skeletal and craniofacial anomalies.

B15_10.process: Regulating endosome maturation, positioning and cargo sorting.

B15_11.process: Building and shaping the tubular ER network.
B15_11.tissue: Most cell types; long corticospinal motor neurons.

B15_12.process: Building and maintaining muscle T-tubules for excitation-contraction coupling.

B15_13.process: Vesicle tethering and fusion at the Golgi in secretion.

B15_14.process: Calcium-activated scrambling of membrane lipids between leaflets.
B15_14.disease: Scott syndrome bleeding disorder; coagulation defects.

B15_15.process: Assembling the skin barrier during keratinocyte terminal differentiation.

B15_16.process: Positioning the ER through contacts with plasma membrane and organelles.

B15_17.process: Forming endosomal tubules for cargo recycling.

B15_18.process: Anchoring membrane protein segments in the ER during insertion.

B15_19.process: Breaking down the nuclear envelope at mitosis.

B15_20.process: Maintaining mature myelin in the central nervous system.
B15_20.disease: Late-onset demyelination, axonal degeneration and leukodystrophy.
B15_20.tissue: Oligodendrocytes in brain and spinal cord.

B15_21.process: Regulating the extent and shape of the tubular ER network.
B15_21.disease: Hereditary spastic paraplegia and Warburg micro syndrome.
B15_21.tissue: Most cell types; long axons and developing nervous system.

B15_22.process: Regulating how much integrin adhesion receptor cells produce.

B15_23.process: Linking Golgi stacks into a continuous ribbon.

B15_24.process: Forming multivesicular bodies to degrade membrane receptors.

B15_25.process: Regulating membrane tubulation and vesicle scission.

B15_26.process: Repairing tears in the plasma membrane.

B15_27.tissue: Most cell types; long motor axons.

B15_28.process: Fusing ER tubules to keep the network continuous.
B15_28.disease: Hereditary spastic paraplegia and sensory neuropathy.
B15_28.tissue: Most cell types; long axons of neurons.

B15_29.process: Acidifying endosomes by pumping protons into them.
